Ownership Leverage

Leverage is a data point — not a talking point. Proj Own vs Fair Own from 925 FPTS, Vegas/win odds, salary, model rank, and optional Custom Model Run A.

Over-owned = more ownership than projections support · Under-owned = opposite

How fair ownership is built

Matches your Ownership Leverage workbook: Proper Own (FPTS²/salary pool × salary tier × blend with Proj Own), Ownership Edge = Proper − Proj, Sheet4 leverage score (cut / model / own mix), Vegas lev rank, and the same tag thresholds (Fade / Over / Proper / Under). Leverage Rank 1 = most under-owned vs fair share. Return-value finish is the place band typically needed at that ownership/price.
